overview.description: The Abacus Flexible Bond Leaders ETF (ABXB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Abacus Flexible Bond Leaders index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index that tactically invests across various fixed income securities. The fund-of-funds may invest in government and corporate bonds, investment grade and junk bonds of any credit quality or maturity from around the world. ABXB was launched on Dec 7, 2020 and is issued by Abacus.
